items.headline: Copilot in Outlook lets you rewrite selected portions instead of regenerating entire drafts
items.summary: Microsoft rolled out a productivity improvement in Outlook allowing users to rewrite only selected portions of an email draft rather than regenerating the entire message. This feature launched in July 2026 alongside Copilot-powered search summaries in Outlook and easier settings management for classic Outlook users.
items.levelshiftAngle: This directly benefits LevelShift teams using M365 Copilot daily for client correspondence and proposal writing. The selective rewrite feature saves time when refining specific sections of technical documentation or client emails without losing context from other paragraphs. Share this tip in the next all-hands and add it to the M365 Copilot onboarding guide for new hires.

items.headline: Claude Opus 5 launches with 1M context window and HIPAA self-serve configuration for Enterprise
items.summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 in July 2026 with a 1 million token context window, 128k max output tokens, and thinking mode enabled by default. The update includes self-serve HIPAA configuration for Enterprise and API organizations, allowing admins to review the Business Associate Agreement and enable HIPAA compliance in a single workflow. Pricing remains unchanged from Opus 4.8.

items.headline: Tempus reports $1.27B revenue in 2025 with 83% growth and AI processing 60K patient records in days
items.summary: Healthcare AI company Tempus reported $1.27 billion in total revenue in 2025 with annual growth above 83% and net revenue retention of 126%. The company used AI to process 60,000 patient records in a matter of days instead of months through manual review, demonstrating measurable time-to-insight improvements at enterprise scale.

items.headline: German court holds medical clinic liable for AI chatbot false qualifications May 2026
items.summary: The Higher Regional Court of Hamm ruled on May 12, 2026 that a medical company is liable for erroneous responses from its AI chatbot regarding physician qualifications. The chatbot falsely stated that two managing directors held specialist titles they did not possess. The court held that whoever uses a chatbot on their site bears the risk of hallucination themselves, particularly in sensitive fields like healthcare.
items.levelshiftAngle: This ruling directly validates LevelShift's 5-Phase Value Realization Framework, particularly Phase 5 Controlled Execution with human-in-the-loop checkpoints for high-stakes interactions. It also underscores why our SOC 2 certification and governance playbooks matter when selling Agentforce or Microsoft Copilot implementations to healthcare and financial services clients. Use this case in sales conversations when positioning structured AI governance as risk mitigation, not overhead. Add it to the Agentforce implementation checklist as a cautionary reference for customer-facing agent deployments.

items.headline: EU AI Act Article 50 transparency obligations enforceable August 2 2026 despite high-risk deadline extension
items.summary: While the EU AI Act granted enterprises a 16-month grace period for high-risk AI systems, Article 50 transparency obligations remain strictly enforceable as of August 2, 2026. All users must be immediately informed when interacting with an AI chatbot or viewing artificially generated content. Enterprise buyers are now asking for AI governance evidence before signing contracts, requiring full data lineage tracking and risk classification tags for each model.
